featured_reviews.name: Aditya Pal
featured_reviews.review_text: I always knew that AMBIKA Book Depot is the 'ONLY' destination in Thakur Village for School and College books, but after it has been closed I never knew about an alternative place to buy reference books which is near to my locality , but I never knew about this beautiful place. The book centre is inside the Thakur college of science and commerce. So enter the campus through GATE 1, and you will see the book centre on your right . There are 2 old men who run the book centre. They have books for colleges as well as entrance exam preparation books like CAT , IBPO ,etc. Although the books might not be of the current year . But if you want to refer through papers of previous years you can buy it from here at a reduced price. And also if you don't need the books you can return them too , you will get some money back too. The old person didn't get angry or irritated as I asked them for more books to see and only buying few of them ( I have experienced worst ), and they were calm . I will encourage you to buy books from here and support them and also if you have any intent to return those books , please keep it in a good condition so that other students who are eager to learn can read from it. Thank you for reading my review . Also one thing to note is that they have a option to pay via Google Pay , but not credit cards.
